triggers.name: new_csv_file
triggers.title: New CSV file
triggers.description: New CSV file added in directory on FTP/FTPS server
triggers.help: Trigger when new lines are added to a CSV file in a FTP directory. Watches first-level directory only. Only CSV files with rows trigger jobs. To pick up new/updated lines in existing CSV files, use the "New/updated file in directory" trigger

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: directory
input.label: Directory
input.hint: Files in this directory will be processed, ordered by ascending modification time.

input.name: separator
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: The character used to separate column values within each CSV row.

input.name: skip_header_line
input.label: Contains header row?
input.hint: Set to Yes if the first CSV row is a header row, containing column names.

input.name: max_batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Number of CSV rows per batch. Instead of reading rows one by one, Workato reads a batch of CSV rows at a time to increase throughput. Learn more

triggers.name: new_file_in_dir
triggers.title: New/updated file in directory
triggers.description: New/updated file in directory on FTP/FTPS server
triggers.help: Watches first-level directory only. This trigger gets the file information. Use 'Download file' action to retrieve the contents of the file

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: directory
input.label: Directory
input.hint: Files in this directory will be processed, ordered by ascending modification time.

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Get file created/updated since the given date/time. Leave empty to get files created/updated 1 hour ago. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

actions.name: get_file_content
actions.title: Download file
actions.description: Download file contents from FTP/FTPS server
actions.help: Use this action to fetch the contents of a file from FTP/FTPS server.

input.name: file_name
input.label: File path
input.hint: Enter the full path of file with extension. For eg. '/directory1/file1.txt'

actions.name: list_directories_files
actions.title: List files and directories
actions.description: List files and directories from FTP/FTPS server
actions.help: Retrieves the first level of files and directories from the specified path.

input.name: directory
input.label: Directory
input.hint: Select the directory

input.name: include_files
input.label: Include files
input.hint: Default to Yes . If Yes , it includes both files and directories. If No , it includes only directories

actions.name: remove
actions.title: Remove file
actions.help: Remove a file on connected FTP/FTPS server. Identify the file to remove with the exact, case sensitive file path. Action will fail if the file is not found.

input.name: filename
input.label: File name
input.hint: File to remove. Use exact, case sensitive file path, e.g. /User/personal folder/file name.txt

actions.name: rename
actions.title: Rename file
actions.description: Rename a file on FTP/FTPS server
actions.help: Rename a file on connected FTP/FTPS server. Identify the file to rename with the exact, case sensitive file path. Action will fail if the file is not found.

input.name: from
input.label: From
input.hint: Existing file name. Use exact, case sensitive file path, e.g. /User/personal folder/source name.txt

input.name: to
input.label: To
input.hint: New file name. E.g. destination name.txt

actions.name: stat
actions.title: Get file information
actions.description: Get information about file via its exact file path on FTP-S server
actions.help: Retrieve information about a file via its specific, case sensitive file path in connected FTP/FTPS server. Action will fail if the file is not found.

input.name: filename
input.label: File name
input.hint: Use exact, case sensitive file path. E.g. /User/personal folder/file name.txt

actions.name: streamable_get_file_content
actions.title: Download large file
actions.description: Download large file contents from FTP/FTPS server
actions.help: Download file contents from FTP/FTPS server. File will be downloaded in binary mode.

input.name: filename
input.label: File path
input.hint: Enter the full path of file with extension. For eg. '/directory1/file1.txt'

input.name: expected_encoding
input.label: Encoding of file content
input.hint: Encoding will be autodetected. This field allows to set it explicitly. Learn more

actions.name: upload
actions.title: Upload file
actions.description: Upload a file to FTP/FTPS server
actions.help: Upload a file into a specified folder in connected FTP/FTPS server.

input.name: filename
input.label: File name
input.hint: File will be created if not already present on the server.Use exact, case sensitive file path including extension, e.g. /User/personal folder/file name.txt will create, append or overwrite file named …

input.name: append
input.label: Append
input.hint: Setting to true will append content to file, false will overwrite the file with new content

input.name: content
input.label: File contents
input.hint: Input text to create a plain text file.
